grammar.q: I was wondering ___ you could take a quick look at my proposal.
grammar.explain_zh: I was wondering 後面用 if 或 whether 帶出一個子句。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Would you mind ___ me the meeting notes?
grammar.explain_zh: Would you mind 後面接 V-ing：Would you mind sending…?
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Would it be possible ___ (borrow) your charger for an hour?
grammar.explain_zh: Would it be possible + to + 原形動詞。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Which request sounds the most polite when asking a busy colleague for help?
options: I was wondering if you could check my report when you have a minute.
You have to check my report.
Why don't you check my report now?
grammar.explain_zh: I was wondering if you could… 加上 when you have a minute，語氣最委婉、也尊重對方時間。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Your coworker asks, "Would you mind covering for me tomorrow?" You are happy to help. What do you say?
grammar.explain_zh: mind 是「介意」。回答 No, not at all（一點也不介意）才是「可以」。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…
